grammar.summary: 本课学习表因果复现的 be due to 与 provided that。

points.title: provided that 表"只要"
points.explanation: The waves are harmless, provided (that) they are far away. provided = on condition that，条件连词。

examples.en: The sea is harmless provided you respect it.
examples.cn: 只要你敬畏大海，它就是无害的。

points.title: 表"恐惧"的 be terrified by
points.explanation: Sailors were terrified by the waves. terrify 的 -ed 感受复现：被吓坏。

examples.en: They were terrified by the sight.
examples.cn: 他们被眼前的景象吓坏了。
